def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Locate the full-width divider.
    div=next((r for r,row in enumerate(g) if all(v==2 for v in row)),None)
    if div is None:
        return g
    bg=max(set(v for row in g for v in row if v!=2), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    # All non-background/non-divider cells form the payload to transport.
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
    if not cells:
        return g
    # Translate payload toward the divider until its nearest row is adjacent.
    if max(r for r,c,v in cells)<div:  # payload above divider, move downward
        delta=(div-1)-max(r for r,c,v in cells)
        far=min(r for r,c,v in cells)+delta-1
    elif min(r for c0 in range(w) for c0 in []):
        return g
    else:  # payload below divider, move upward
        delta=(div+1)-min(r for r,c,v in cells)
        far=max(r for r,c,v in cells)+delta+1
    # Clear old payload, translate it, and draw the 8 stripe immediately
    # beyond its far edge (on the side opposite the divider).
    for r,c,v in cells:
        g[r][c]=bg
    moved=[(r+delta,c,v) for r,c,v in cells]
    for r,c,v in moved:
        if 0<=r<h:
            g[r][c]=v
    if 0<=far<h:
        g[far]=[8]*w
    return g
PY

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    if divider is None:
        return out
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 2}
    background = max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    obj = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if grid[r][c] not in (2, background)]
    if not obj:
        return out
    rmin = min(r for r, c, v in obj)
    rmax = max(r for r, c, v in obj)
    if rmax < divider:
        delta = divider - 1 - rmax
        stripe = rmin + delta - 1
    elif rmin > divider:
        delta = divider + 1 - rmin
        stripe = rmax + delta + 1
    else:
        return out
    for r, c, v in obj:
        out[r][c] = background
    for r, c, v in obj:
        out[r + delta][c] = v
    if 0 <= stripe < h:
        out[stripe] = [8] * w
    return out
